settings.heading: Complete the plan
settings.text: Formulations work best alongside a consult and a course — that is how causes get treated.

settings.question: Will anyone know what I ordered?
settings.answer: No. Plain brown parcel, no product name outside, neutral invoice.

settings.question: Can I pay on delivery?
settings.answer: Yes — COD is available across India, along with UPI, cards and netbanking.
